It hoped they would learn how shop-floor lighting 1 workers’ productivity. Instead, the studies ended 2 giving their name to the “Hawthorne effect”, the extremely influential idea that the very 3 of being experimented upon changed subjects’ behavior.

paragraphs.sourceText: The idea arose because of the 4 behavior of the women in the plant. It did not 6 what was done in the experiment; 7 something was changed, productivity rose. A(n) 8 that they were being experimented upon seemed to be 9 to alter workers’ behavior 10 itself.

paragraphs.sourceText: It turns out that the peculiar way of conducting the experiments may have led to 14 interpretations of what happened. 15 , lighting was always changed on a Sunday. When work started again on Monday, output 16 rose compared with the previous Saturday and 17 to rise for the next couple of days. 18 , a comparison with data for weeks when there was no experimentation showed that output always went up on Mondays. Workers 19 to be diligent for the first few days of the week in any case, before 20 a plateau and then slackening off. This suggests that the alleged “Hawthorne effect” is hard to pin down.
paragraphs.translationZh: 事实证明，进行实验的特殊方式可能导致对所发生的事情产生误导性的解释。例如，周日照明总是会改变。周一重新开工后，产量较上周六适当回升，并在接下来的几天继续上涨。然而，与没有进行实验的数周数据进行比较表明，产量总是在周一上升。无论如何，工人们在一周的头几天往往会很勤奋，然后就会陷入停滞状态，然后放松下来。这表明所谓的“霍桑效应”很难确定。

paragraphs.sourceText: Of all the changes that have taken place in English-language newspapers during the past quarter-century, perhaps the most far-reaching has been the inexorable decline in the scope and seriousness of their arts coverage.
paragraphs.translationZh: 在过去四分之一个世纪中英文报纸发生的所有变化中，影响最深远的也许是其艺术报道的范围和严肃性不可避免地下降。

paragraphs.sourceText: It is difficult to the point of impossibility for the average reader under the age of forty to imagine a time when high-quality arts criticism could be found in most big-city newspapers. Yet a considerable number of the most significant collections of criticism published in the 20th century consisted in large part of newspaper reviews. To read such books today is to marvel at the fact that their learned contents were once deemed suitable for publication in general-circulation dailies.
paragraphs.translationZh: 对于四十岁以下的普通读者来说，很难想象有一天在大多数大城市的报纸上都能找到高质量的艺术评论。然而，20 世纪出版的相当多的最重要的批评集很大一部分是报纸评论。今天读到这些书，你会惊叹它们所学的内容曾经被认为适合在大众发行的日报上发表。

paragraphs.sourceText: We are even farther removed from the unfocused newspaper reviews published in England between the turn of the 20th century and the eve of World War Ⅱ, at a time when newsprint was dirt-cheap and stylish arts criticism was considered an ornament to the publications in which it appeared. In those far-off days, it was taken for granted that the critics of major papers would write in detail and at length about the events they covered. Theirs was a serious business, and even those reviewers who wore their learning lightly, like George Bernard Shaw and Ernest Newman, could be trusted to know what they were about. These men believed in journalism as a calling, and were proud to be published in the daily press. “So few authors have brains enough or literary gift enough to keep their own end up in journalism,” Newman wrote, “that I am tempted to define ‘journalism’ as ‘a term of contempt applied by writers who are not read to writers who are’.”
paragraphs.translationZh: 我们更远离20世纪之交和第二次世界大战前夕期间英国出版的没有重点的报纸评论，当时新闻纸非常便宜，时尚的艺术批评被认为是其出现的出版物的装饰品。在那些遥远的日子里，人们理所当然地认为主要报纸的批评者会详细而详细地描述他们所报道的事件。他们的工作是一项严肃的工作，即使是那些对自己的学识不屑一顾的评论家，如萧伯纳和欧内斯特·纽曼，也可以相信他们知道他们的内容。这些人相信新闻事业是一种使命，并为能在日报上发表文章而感到自豪。纽曼写道：“很少有作家有​​足够的头脑或文学天赋来让自己在新闻业中保住自己的结局，因此我很想将‘新闻’定义为‘一个不被读过书的作家对读过书的作家所使用的蔑视术语’。”

paragraphs.sourceText: Unfortunately, these critics are virtually forgotten. Neville Cardus, who wrote for the Manchester Guardian from 1917 until shortly before his death in 1975, is now known solely as a writer of essays on the game of cricket. During his lifetime, though, he was also one of England’s foremost classical-music critics, and a stylist so widely admired that his Autobiography (1947) became a best-seller. He was knighted in 1967, the first music critic to be so honored. Yet only one of his books is now in print, and his vast body of writings on music is unknown save to specialists.
paragraphs.translationZh: 不幸的是，这些批评者几乎被遗忘了。内维尔·卡杜斯 (Neville Cardus) 从 1917 年起一直为《曼彻斯特卫报》撰稿，直到 1975 年去世前不久，现在他仅以撰写有关板球比赛的文章而闻名。不过，在他的一生中，他也是英国最重要的古典音乐评论家之一，也是一位广受赞赏的风格家，他的自传（1947）成为畅销书。 1967年，他被封为爵士，成为第一位获此殊荣的音乐评论家。然而，他现在只出版了一本书，而他大量的音乐著作除了专家之外无人知晓。

paragraphs.sourceText: Is there any chance that Cardus’s criticism will enjoy a revival? The prospect seems remote. Journalistic tastes had changed long before his death, and postmodern readers have little use for the richly upholstered Vicwardian prose in which he specialized. Moreover, the amateur tradition in music criticism has been in headlong retreat.
paragraphs.translationZh: 卡杜斯的批评有可能复兴吗？这个前景似乎很遥远。早在他去世之前，新闻界的品味就已经发生了变化，后现代读者对他所擅长的华丽的维多利亚式散文几乎没有什么用处。此外，音乐批评的业余传统已经在急速退却。

paragraphs.sourceText: Over the past decade, thousands of patents have been granted for what are called business methods. Amazon.com received one for its “one-click” online payment system. Merrill Lynch got legal protection for an asset allocation strategy. One inventor patented a technique for lifting a box.
paragraphs.translationZh: 在过去的十年里，数千项所谓的商业方法专利被授予。亚马逊因其“一键式”在线支付系统而获得了一项殊荣。美林的资产配置策略获得了法律保护。一位发明家申请了一项举起盒子的技术的专利。

paragraphs.sourceText: Now the nation’s top patent court appears completely ready to scale back on business-method patents, which have been controversial ever since they were first authorized 10 years ago. In a move that has intellectual-property lawyers abuzz, the US Court of Appeals for the Federal Circuit said it would use a particular case to conduct a broad review of business-method patents. In re Bilski, as the case is known, is “a very big deal,” says Dennis D. Crouch of the University of Missouri School of Law. It “has the potential to eliminate an entire class of patents.”
paragraphs.translationZh: 现在，美国最高专利法院似乎已完全准备好缩减商业方法专利的申请规模，这些专利自十年前首次授权以来一直备受争议。美国联邦巡回上诉法院表示，将利用一个特定案件对商业方法专利进行广泛的审查，此举引起了知识产权律师的热议。密苏里大学法学院的丹尼斯·D·克劳奇 (Dennis D. Crouch) 表示，众所周知，比尔斯基案是“一件大事”。它“有可能消除一整类专利。”

paragraphs.sourceText: Curbs on business-method claims would be a dramatic about-face, because it was the Federal Circuit itself that introduced such patents with its 1998 decision in the so-called State Street Bank case, approving a patent on a way of pooling mutual-fund assets. That ruling produced an explosion in business-method patent filings, initially by emerging Internet companies trying to stake out exclusive rights to specific types of online transactions. Later, more established companies raced to add such patents to their files, if only as a defensive move against rivals that might beat them to the punch. In 2005, IBM noted in a court filing that it had been issued more than 300 business-method patents, despite the fact that it questioned the legal basis for granting them. Similarly, some Wall Street investment firms armed themselves with patents for financial products, even as they took positions in court cases opposing the practice.
paragraphs.translationZh: 对商业方法索赔的限制将是一个戏剧性的大转变，因为正是联邦巡回法院本身在 1998 年在所谓的道富银行案中做出的裁决中引入了此类专利，批准了一项关于汇集共同基金资产的方式的专利。该裁决导致商业方法专利申请激增，最初是新兴互联网公司试图争夺特定类型在线交易的专有权。后来，更多的老牌公司竞相将此类专利添加到他们的档案中，哪怕只是作为一种防御举措，以对抗可能先发制人的竞争对手。 2005年，IBM在一份法庭文件中指出，它已经获得了300多项商业方法专利，尽管它对授予这些专利的法律依据提出了质疑。同样，一些华尔街投资公司用金融产品专利武装自己，尽管他们在法庭案件中表明了反对这种做法的立场。

paragraphs.sourceText: The Bilski case involves a claimed patent on a method for hedging risk in the energy market. The Federal Circuit issued an unusual order stating that the case would be heard by all 12 of the court’s judges, rather than a typical panel of three, and that one issue it wants to evaluate is whether it should “reconsider” its State Street Bank ruling.
paragraphs.translationZh: 比尔斯基案涉及一项有关能源市场风险对冲方法的专利。联邦巡回法院发布了一项不同寻常的命令，规定该案将由法院所有 12 名法官审理，而不是典型的三人小组，并且它想要评估的一个问题是是否应该“重新考虑”其道富银行的裁决。

paragraphs.sourceText: The Federal Circuit’s action comes in the wake of a series of recent decisions by the Supreme Court that has narrowed the scope of protections for patent holders. Last April, for example, the justices signaled that too many patents were being upheld for “inventions” that are obvious. The judges on the Federal Circuit are “reacting to the anti-patent trend at the
paragraphs.translationZh: 联邦巡回法院的行动是在最高法院最近做出一系列缩小专利持有人保护范围的决定之后采取的。例如，去年四月，法官们表示，太多明显的“发明”专利得到了维护。联邦巡回法院的法官“正在对世界范围内的反专利趋势做出反应”。

paragraphs.sourceText: In his book The Tipping Point, Malcolm Gladwell argues that “social epidemics” are driven in large part by the actions of a tiny minority of special individuals, often called influentials, who are unusually informed, persuasive, or well connected. The idea is intuitively compelling, but it doesn’t explain how ideas actually spread.
paragraphs.translationZh: 马尔科姆·格拉德威尔在他的《引爆点》一书中指出，“社会流行病”在很大程度上是由极少数特殊个体的行为驱动的，这些特殊个体通常被称为有影响力的人，他们消息灵通、有说服力或人脉广泛。这个想法在直觉上很引人注目，但它并没有解释想法实际上是如何传播的。

paragraphs.sourceText: The supposed importance of influentials derives from a plausible-sounding but largely untested theory called the “two-step flow of communication”: Information flows from the media to the influentials and from them to everyone else. Marketers have embraced the two-step flow because it suggests that if they can just find and influence the influentials, those select people will do most of the work for them. The theory also seems to explain the sudden and unexpected popularity of certain looks, brands, or neighborhoods. In many such cases, a cursory search for causes finds that some small group of people was wearing, promoting, or developing whatever it is before anyone else paid attention. Anecdotal evidence of this kind fits nicely with the idea that only certain special people can drive trends.
paragraphs.translationZh: 有影响力的所谓重要性源自一种听起来似乎合理但基本上未经检验的理论，称为“两步传播流”：信息从媒体流向有影响力的人，然后从他们流向其他人。营销人员已经接受了两步流程，因为它表明，如果他们能够找到并影响有影响力的人，那么那些选定的人将为他们做大部分工作。这个理论似乎也解释了某些造型、品牌或社区突然出人意料地流行的原因。在许多这样的案例中，粗略地寻找原因就会发现，有一小群人在其他人注意到之前就开始穿着、推广或开发任何东西。此类轶事证据非常符合这样的观点：只有某些特殊的人才能推动趋势。

paragraphs.sourceText: In their recent work, however, some researchers have come up with the finding that influentials have far less impact on social epidemics than is generally supposed. In fact, they don’t seem to be required at all.
paragraphs.translationZh: 然而，在最近的研究中，一些研究人员发现，有影响力的人对社会流行病的影响远小于人们普遍认为的。事实上，它们似乎根本不需要。

paragraphs.sourceText: The researchers’ argument stems from a simple observation about social influence: With the exception of a few celebrities like Oprah Winfrey — whose outsize presence is primarily a function of media, not interpersonal influence — even the most influential members of a population simply don’t interact with that many others. Yet it is precisely these non-celebrity influentials who, according to the two-step-flow theory, are supposed to drive social epidemics, by influencing their friends and colleagues directly. For a social epidemic to occur, however, each person so affected must then influence his or her own acquaintances, who must in turn influence theirs, and so on; and just how many others pay attention to each of these people has little to do with the initial influential. If people in the network just two degrees removed from the initial influential prove resistant, for example, the cascade of change won’t propagate very far or affect many people.
paragraphs.translationZh: 研究人员的论点源于对社会影响力的一个简单观察：除了奥普拉·温弗瑞（Oprah Winfrey）这样的少数名人（他们的巨大影响力主要是媒体的作用，而不是人际影响力）之外，即使是人群中最有影响力的成员也不会与那么多其他人互动。然而，根据两步流理论，正是这些非名人影响力人士应该通过直接影响他们的朋友和同事来推动社会流行病。然而，要发生社会流行病，每个受到如此影响的人都必须影响他或她自己的熟人，而这些人又必须影响他们的熟人，依此类推；而有多少人关注这些人，与最初的影响力无关。例如，如果网络中的人们与最初的影响力相距仅两度，那么一连串的变化就不会传播很远，也不会影响很多人。

paragraphs.sourceText: Building on the basic truth about interpersonal influence, the researchers studied the dynamics of social influence by conducting thousands of computer simulations of populations, manipulating a number of variables relating to people’s ability to influence others and their tendency to be influenced. They found that the principal requirement for what is called “global cascades” — the widespread propagation of influence through networks — is the presence not of a few influentials but, rather, of a critical mass of easily influenced people.
paragraphs.translationZh: 基于人际影响力的基本事实，研究人员通过对人群进行数千次计算机模拟，操纵许多与人们影响他人的能力和受影响倾向相关的变量，研究了社会影响力的动态。他们发现，所谓的“全球级联”——通过网络广泛传播影响力——的主要要求不是少数有影响力的人的存在，而是大量容易受到影响的人的存在。

paragraphs.sourceText: Bankers have been blaming themselves for their troubles in public. Behind the scenes, they have been taking aim at someone else: the accounting standard-setters. Their rules, moan the banks, have forced them to report enormous losses, and it’s just not fair. These rules say they must value some assets at the price a third party would pay, not the price managers and regulators would like them to fetch.
paragraphs.translationZh: 银行家们一直在公开场合为自己的麻烦而自责。在幕后，他们一直把矛头指向另一个人：会计准则制定者。银行抱怨说，他们的规则迫使他们报告巨额损失，这是不公平的。这些规则规定，他们必须按照第三方支付的价格对某些资产进行估值，而不是价格管理者和监管机构希望他们获得的价格。

paragraphs.sourceText: Unfortunately, banks’ lobbying now seems to be working. The details may be unknowable, but the independence of standard-setters, essential to the proper functioning of capital markets, is being compromised. And, unless banks carry toxic assets at prices that attract buyers, reviving the banking system will be difficult.
paragraphs.translationZh: 不幸的是，银行的游说现在似乎起了作用。细节可能不可知，但对于资本市场正常运作至关重要的标准制定者的独立性正在受到损害。而且，除非银行以吸引买家的价格持有有毒资产，否则重振银行体系将很困难。

paragraphs.sourceText: After a bruising encounter with Congress, America’s Financial Accounting Standards Board (FASB) rushed through rule changes. These gave banks more freedom to use models to value illiquid assets and more flexibility in recognizing losses on long-term assets in their income statements. Bob Herz, the FASB’s chairman, cried out against those who “question our motives.” Yet bank shares rose and the changes enhance what one lobbying group politely calls “the use of judgment by management.”
paragraphs.translationZh: 在与国会发生激烈冲突后，美国财务会计准则委员会（FASB）匆忙修改了规则。这些使银行能够更自由地使用模型对非流动资产进行估值，并更灵活地在损益表中确认长期资产损失。 FASB 主席鲍勃·赫兹 (Bob Herz) 大声疾呼反对那些“质疑我们动机”的人。然而，银行股价上涨，这些变化增强了一个游说团体礼貌地称之为“管理层判断力的运用”。

paragraphs.sourceText: European ministers instantly demanded that the International Accounting Standards Board (IASB) do likewise. The IASB says it does not want to act without overall planning, but the pressure to fold when it completes its reconstruction of rules later this year is strong. Charlie McCreevy, a European commissioner, warned the IASB that it did “not live in a political vacuum” but “in the real world” and that Europe could yet develop different rules.
paragraphs.translationZh: 欧洲部长们立即要求国际会计准则理事会（IASB）也这样做。 IASB 表示，它不想在没有总体规划的情况下采取行动，但在今年晚些时候完成规则重建时，它面临着很大的压力。欧盟委员查理·麦克里维 (Charlie McCreevy) 警告 IASB，它“并非生活在政治真空中”，而是“生活在现实世界中”，欧洲仍可能制定不同的规则。

paragraphs.sourceText: It was banks that were on the wrong planet, with accounts that vastly overvalued assets. Today they argue that market prices overstate losses, because they largely reflect the temporary illiquidity of markets, not the likely extent of bad debts. The truth will not be known for years. But banks’ shares trade below their book value, suggesting that investors are skeptical. And dead markets partly reflect the paralysis of banks which will not sell assets for fear of booking losses, yet are reluctant to buy all those supposed bargains.
paragraphs.translationZh: 银行是在错误的星球上，其账户大大高估了资产。如今，他们认为市场价格夸大了损失，因为它们在很大程度上反映了市场暂时的流动性不足，而不是坏账的可能程度。真相多年后才会为人所知。但银行股票的交易价格低于其账面价值，表明投资者对此持怀疑态度。死气沉沉的市场在一定程度上反映了银行的瘫痪，它们因担心账面损失而不会出售资产，但又不愿购买所有那些所谓的便宜货。

paragraphs.sourceText: To get the system working again, losses must be recognized and dealt with. America’s new plan to buy up toxic assets will not work unless banks mark assets to levels which buyers find attractive. Successful markets require independent and even combative standard-setters. The FASB and IASB have been exactly that, cleaning up rules on stock options and pensions, for example, against hostility from special interests. But by giving in to critics now they are inviting pressure to make more concessions.
paragraphs.translationZh: 为了使系统重新运行，必须承认并处理损失。除非银行将资产定价到买家认为有吸引力的水平，否则美国收购有毒资产的新计划将不会奏效。成功的市场需要独立的、甚至是好斗的标准制定者。 FASB 和 IASB 正是这样做的，清理了股票期权和养老金等规则，以应对特殊利益集团的敌意。但现在向批评者屈服，他们正在招致做出更多让步的压力。

paragraphs.sourceText: For questions 41-45, choose the most suitable paragraphs from the list A-G and fill them into the numbered boxes to form a coherent text. Paragraph E has been correctly placed. There is one paragraph which does not fit in with the text. Mark your answers on ANSWER SHEET 1. (10 points)

paragraphs.sourceText: A) The first and more important is the consumer’s growing preference for eating out: the consumption of food and drink in places other than homes has risen from about 32 percent of total consumption in 1995 to 35 percent in 2000 and is expected to approach 38 percent by 2005. This development is boosting wholesale demand from the food service segment by 4 to 5 percent a year across Europe, compared with growth in retail demand of 1 to 2 percent. Meanwhile, as the recession is looming large, people are getting anxious. They tend to keep a tighter hold on their purse and consider eating at home a realistic alternative.
paragraphs.translationZh: A) 第一个也是更重要的是消费者越来越喜欢外出就餐：在家庭以外的地方食品和饮料的消费量已从 1995 年占总消费量的 32% 上升到 2000 年的 35%，预计到 2005 年将接近 38%。这一发展正在推动欧洲食品服务领域的批发需求每年增长 4% 到 5%，而零售需求的增长则为 1% 到 2%。与此同时，随着经济衰退的日益严重，人们变得焦虑起来。他们往往会更严格地控​​制自己的钱包，并认为在家吃饭是一个现实的选择。

paragraphs.sourceText: B) Retail sales of food and drink in Europe’s largest markets are at a standstill, leaving European grocery retailers hungry for opportunities to grow. Most leading retailers have already tried e-commerce, with limited success, and expansion abroad. But almost all have ignored the big, profitable opportunity in their own backyard: the wholesale food and drink trade, which appears to be just the kind of market retailers need.
paragraphs.translationZh: B）欧洲最大市场的食品和饮料零售销售陷入停滞，使得欧洲杂货零售商渴望增长机会。大多数领先的零售商已经尝试过电子商务，但成效有限，并开始向海外扩张。但几乎所有人都忽视了自家后院的巨大盈利机会：食品和饮料批发贸易，这似乎正是零售商所需要的市场类型。

paragraphs.sourceText: C) Will such variations bring about a change in the overall structure of the food and drink market? Definitely not. The functioning of the market is based on flexible trends dominated by potential buyers. In other words, it is up to the buyer, rather than the seller, to decide what to buy. At any rate, this change will ultimately be acclaimed by an ever-growing number of both domestic and international consumers, regardless of how long the current consumer pattern will take hold.
paragraphs.translationZh: C) 这种变化是否会带来食品饮料市场整体结构的变化？绝对不是。市场的运作基于潜在买家主导的灵活趋势。换句话说，买什么是由买方而不是卖方决定的。无论如何，无论当前的消费模式将持续多久，这一变化最终将受到越来越多的国内外消费者的欢迎。

paragraphs.sourceText: D) All in all, this clearly seems to be a market in which big retailers could profitably apply their gigantic scale, existing infrastructure, and proven skills in the management of product ranges, logistics, and marketing intelligence. Retailers that master the intricacies of wholesaling in Europe may well expect to rake in substantial profits thereby. At least, that is how it looks as a whole. Closer inspection reveals important differences among the biggest national markets, especially in their customer segments and wholesale structures, as well as the competitive dynamics of individual food and drink categories. Big retailers must understand these differences before they can identify the segments of European wholesaling in which their particular abilities might unseat smaller but entrenched competitors. New skills and unfamiliar business models are needed too.
paragraphs.translationZh: D) 总而言之，这显然是一个大型零售商可以利用其巨大规模、现有基础设施以及在产品系列管理、物流和营销情报方面经过验证的技能来获利的市场。掌握了欧洲复杂的批发业务的零售商很可能会因此获得可观的利润。至少，整体看起来是这样。更仔细的检查揭示了最大的国家市场之间的重要差异，特别是在其客户群和批发结构以及各个食品和饮料类别的竞争动态方面。大型零售商必须先了解这些差异，然后才能确定欧洲批发业的哪些细分市场，在这些细分市场中，他们的特殊能力可能会取代规模较小但根深蒂固的竞争对手。还需要新的技能和不熟悉的商业模式。

paragraphs.sourceText: E) Despite variations in detail, wholesale markets in the countries that have been closely examined — France, Germany, Italy and Spain — are made out of the same building blocks. Demand comes mainly from two sources: independent mom-and-pop grocery stores which, unlike large retail chains, are too small to buy straight from producers, and food service operators that cater to consumers when they don’t eat at home. Such food service operators range from snack machines to large institutional catering ventures, but most of these businesses are known in the trade as “horeca”: hotels, restaurants and cafés. Overall, Europe’s wholesale market for food and drink is growing at the same sluggish pace as the retail market, but the figures, when added together, mask two opposing trends.
paragraphs.translationZh: E）尽管细节有所不同，但经过仔细研究的国家（法国、德国、意大利和西班牙）的批发市场都是由相同的组成部分组成的。需求主要来自两个来源：独立的夫妻杂货店，与大型零售连锁店不同，规模太小，无法直接从生产商那里购买；以及食品服务运营商，为不在家吃饭的消费者提供服务。此类食品服务运营商的范围从小吃机到大型机构餐饮企业，但其中大多数企业在行业中被称为“horeca”：酒店、餐馆和咖啡馆。总体而言，欧洲食品和饮料批发市场的增长速度与零售市场相同，但这些数字加在一起却掩盖了两种相反的趋势。

paragraphs.sourceText: F) For example, wholesale food and drink sales came to $268 billion in France, Germany, Italy, Spain, and the United Kingdom in 2000 — more than 40 percent of retail sales. Moreover, average overall margins are higher in wholesale than in retail; wholesale demand from the food service sector is growing quickly as more Europeans eat out more often; and changes in the competitive dynamics of this fragmented industry are at last making it feasible for wholesalers to consolidate.
paragraphs.translationZh: F) 例如，2000 年，法国、德国、意大利、西班牙和英国的食品和饮料批发销售额达到 2,680 亿美元，占零售销售额的 40% 以上。此外，批发业的平均总体利润率高于零售业；随着越来越多的欧洲人更频繁地外出就餐，食品服务行业的批发需求正在迅速增长；这个分散行业的竞争动态的变化最终使批发商可以进行整合。

paragraphs.sourceText: G) However, none of these requirements should deter large retailers (and even some large food producers and existing wholesalers) from trying their hand, for those that master the intricacies of wholesaling in Europe stand to reap considerable gains.
paragraphs.translationZh: G) 然而，这些要求都不应阻止大型零售商（甚至一些大型食品生产商和现有批发商）尝试他们的手，因为那些掌握了欧洲批发的复杂性的人将获得可观的收益。

paragraphs.sourceText: Read the following text carefully and then translate the underlined segments into Chinese. Your translation should be written clearly on ANSWER SHEET 2. (10 points)
paragraphs.translationZh: 仔细阅读下面的文字，然后将划线部分翻译成中文。您的翻译应清楚地写在答题卡 2 上。（10 分）

paragraphs.sourceText: One basic weakness in a conservation system based wholly on economic motives is that most members of the land community have no economic value. Yet these creatures are members of the biotic community and, if its stability depends on its integrity, they are entitled to continuance.
paragraphs.translationZh: 完全基于经济动机的保护制度的一个基本弱点是，土地社区的大多数成员没有经济价值。然而，这些生物是生物群落的成员，如果其稳定性取决于其完整性，它们就有权继续存在。

paragraphs.sourceText: When one of these noneconomic categories is threatened and, if we happen to love it, we invent excuses to give it economic importance. At the beginning of the century songbirds were supposed to be disappearing. (46) Scientists jumped to the rescue with some distinctly shaky evidence to the effect that insects would eat us up if birds failed to control them. The evidence had to be economic in order to be valid.
paragraphs.translationZh: 当这些非经济类别之一受到威胁时，如果我们碰巧喜欢它，我们就会找借口赋予它经济重要性。在本世纪初，鸣禽被认为正在消失。 (46) 科学家们立即采取了一些明显站不住脚的证据来拯救我们，这些证据表明，如果鸟类不能控制昆虫，昆虫就会吃掉我们。证据必须是经济的才能有效。

paragraphs.sourceText: It is painful to read these roundabout accounts today. We have no land ethic yet, (47) but we have at least drawn nearer the point of admitting that birds should continue as a matter of intrinsic right, regardless of the presence or absence of economic advantage to us.
paragraphs.translationZh: 今天读到这些迂回的叙述令人痛苦。我们还没有土地伦理，（47）但我们至少更接近承认鸟类应该作为一种固有权利继续存在，无论我们是否存在经济优势。

paragraphs.sourceText: A parallel situation exists in respect of predatory mammals and fish-eating birds. (48) Time was when biologists somewhat overworked the evidence that these creatures preserve the health of game by killing the physically weak, or that they prey only on “worthless” species. Here again, the evidence had to be economic in order to be valid. It is only in recent years that we hear the more honest argument that predators are members of the community, and that no special interest has the right to exterminate them for the sake of a benefit, real or fancied, to itself.
paragraphs.translationZh: 掠食性哺乳动物和食鱼鸟类也存在类似情况。 (48) 生物学家有时过分夸大了证据，证明这些生物通过杀死身体虚弱的动物来维持猎物的健康，或者它们只捕食“无价值”的物种。同样，证据必须是经济的才能有效。直到最近几年，我们才听到更诚实的论点，即掠夺者是社会的成员，任何特殊利益集团都无权为了自身的利益（无论是真实的还是想象的）而消灭它们。

paragraphs.sourceText: Some species of trees have been “read out of the party” by economics-minded foresters because they grow too slowly, or have too low a sale value to pay as timber crops. (49) In Europe, where forestry is ecologically more advanced, the noncommercial tree species are recognized as members of the native forest community, to be preserved as such, within reason. Moreover, some have been found to have a valuable function in building up soil fertility. The interdependence of the forest and its constituent tree species, ground flora, and fauna is taken for granted.
paragraphs.translationZh: 有些树种已经被有经济头脑的林务人员“排除在外”，因为它们生长太慢，或者销售价值太低，无法作为用材作物支付。 (49) 在欧洲，林业在生态上更为先进，非商业树种被认为是原生森林群落的成员，并在合理范围内得到保护。此外，一些已被发现在增强土壤肥力方面具有宝贵的功能。森林及其组成树种、地面植物群和动物群的相互依存被认为是理所当然的。

paragraphs.sourceText: To sum up: a system of conservation based solely on economic self-interest is hopelessly lopsided. (50) It tends to ignore, and thus eventually to eliminate, many elements in the land community that lack commercial value, but that are essential to its healthy functioning. It assumes, falsely, that the economic parts of the biotic clock will function without the uneconomic parts.
paragraphs.translationZh: 总而言之：仅仅基于经济自身利益的保护体系是完全不平衡的。 (50) 它往往会忽视并最终消除土地社区中缺乏商业价值但对其健康运作至关重要的许多要素。它错误地假设生物钟的经济部分在没有不经济部分的情况下也能发挥作用。

options.sourceText: The first and more important is the consumer’s growing preference for eating out: the consumption of food and drink in places other than homes has risen from about 32 percent of total consumption in 1995 to 35 percent in 2000 and is expected to approach 38 percent by 2005. This development is boosting wholesale demand from the food service segment by 4 to 5 percent a year across Europe, compared with growth in retail demand of 1 to 2 percent. Meanwhile, as the recession is looming large, people are getting anxious. They tend to keep a tighter hold on their purse and consider eating at home a realistic alternative.
options.translationZh: A) 第一个也是更重要的是消费者越来越喜欢外出就餐：在家庭以外的地方食品和饮料的消费量已从 1995 年占总消费量的 32% 上升到 2000 年的 35%，预计到 2005 年将接近 38%。这一发展正在推动欧洲食品服务领域的批发需求每年增长 4% 到 5%，而零售需求的增长则为 1% 到 2%。与此同时，随着经济衰退的日益严重，人们变得焦虑起来。他们往往会更严格地控​​制自己的钱包，并认为在家吃饭是一个现实的选择。

options.sourceText: Retail sales of food and drink in Europe’s largest markets are at a standstill, leaving European grocery retailers hungry for opportunities to grow. Most leading retailers have already tried e-commerce, with limited success, and expansion abroad. But almost all have ignored the big, profitable opportunity in their own backyard: the wholesale food and drink trade, which appears to be just the kind of market retailers need.
options.translationZh: B）欧洲最大市场的食品和饮料零售销售陷入停滞，使得欧洲杂货零售商渴望增长机会。大多数领先的零售商已经尝试过电子商务，但成效有限，并开始向海外扩张。但几乎所有人都忽视了自家后院的巨大盈利机会：食品和饮料批发贸易，这似乎正是零售商所需要的市场类型。

options.sourceText: Will such variations bring about a change in the overall structure of the food and drink market? Definitely not. The functioning of the market is based on flexible trends dominated by potential buyers. In other words, it is up to the buyer, rather than the seller, to decide what to buy. At any rate, this change will ultimately be acclaimed by an ever-growing number of both domestic and international consumers, regardless of how long the current consumer pattern will take hold.
options.translationZh: C) 这种变化是否会带来食品饮料市场整体结构的变化？绝对不是。市场的运作基于潜在买家主导的灵活趋势。换句话说，买什么是由买方而不是卖方决定的。无论如何，无论当前的消费模式将持续多久，这一变化最终将受到越来越多的国内外消费者的欢迎。

options.sourceText: All in all, this clearly seems to be a market in which big retailers could profitably apply their gigantic scale, existing infrastructure, and proven skills in the management of product ranges, logistics, and marketing intelligence. Retailers that master the intricacies of wholesaling in Europe may well expect to rake in substantial profits thereby. At least, that is how it looks as a whole. Closer inspection reveals important differences among the biggest national markets, especially in their customer segments and wholesale structures, as well as the competitive dynamics of individual food and drink categories. Big retailers must understand these differences before they can identify the segments of European wholesaling in which their particular abilities might unseat smaller but entrenched competitors. New skills and unfamiliar business models are needed too.
options.translationZh: D) 总而言之，这显然是一个大型零售商可以利用其巨大规模、现有基础设施以及在产品系列管理、物流和营销情报方面经过验证的技能来获利的市场。掌握了欧洲复杂的批发业务的零售商很可能会因此获得可观的利润。至少，整体看起来是这样。更仔细的检查揭示了最大的国家市场之间的重要差异，特别是在其客户群和批发结构以及各个食品和饮料类别的竞争动态方面。大型零售商必须先了解这些差异，然后才能确定欧洲批发业的哪些细分市场，在这些细分市场中，他们的特殊能力可能会取代规模较小但根深蒂固的竞争对手。还需要新的技能和不熟悉的商业模式。

options.sourceText: For example, wholesale food and drink sales came to $268 billion in France, Germany, Italy, Spain, and the United Kingdom in 2000 — more than 40 percent of retail sales. Moreover, average overall margins are higher in wholesale than in retail; wholesale demand from the food service sector is growing quickly as more Europeans eat out more often; and changes in the competitive dynamics of this fragmented industry are at last making it feasible for wholesalers to consolidate.
options.translationZh: F) 例如，2000 年，法国、德国、意大利、西班牙和英国的食品和饮料批发销售额达到 2,680 亿美元，占零售销售额的 40% 以上。此外，批发业的平均总体利润率高于零售业；随着越来越多的欧洲人更频繁地外出就餐，食品服务行业的批发需求正在迅速增长；这个分散行业的竞争动态的变化最终使批发商可以进行整合。

options.sourceText: However, none of these requirements should deter large retailers (and even some large food producers and existing wholesalers) from trying their hand, for those that master the intricacies of wholesaling in Europe stand to reap considerable gains.
options.translationZh: G) 然而，这些要求都不应阻止大型零售商（甚至一些大型食品生产商和现有批发商）尝试他们的手，因为那些掌握了欧洲批发的复杂性的人将获得可观的收益。

options.sourceText: The first and more important is the consumer’s growing preference for eating out: the consumption of food and drink in places other than homes has risen from about 32 percent of total consumption in 1995 to 35 percent in 2000 and is expected to approach 38 percent by 2005. Meanwhile, as the recession is looming large, people are getting anxious. They tend to keep a tighter hold on their purse and consider eating at home a realistic alternative.

options.sourceText: Retail sales of food and drink in Europe’s largest markets are at a standstill, leaving European grocery retailers hungry for opportunities to grow. Most leading retailers have already tried e-commerce, with limited success, and expansion abroad. But almost all have ignored the big, profitable opportunity in their own backyard: the wholesale food and drink trade, which appears to be just the kind of market retailers need.

options.sourceText: Will such variations bring about a change in the overall structure of the food and drink market? Definitely not. The functioning of the market is based on flexible trends dominated by potential buyers. In other words, it is up to the buyer, rather than the seller, to decide what to buy. At any rate, this change will ultimately be acclaimed by an ever-growing number of both domestic and international consumers, regardless of how long the current consumer pattern will take hold.

options.sourceText: All in all, this clearly seems to be a market in which big retailers could profitably apply their gigantic scale, existing infrastructure, and proven skills in the management of product ranges, logistics, and marketing intelligence. Big retailers must understand these differences before they can identify the segments of European wholesaling in which their particular abilities might unseat smaller but entrenched competitors. New skills and unfamiliar business models are needed too.
